jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(G) inventory: Readsboro School District, a town school district in the Windham Southwest Supervisory Union (member town: Readsboro). Non-operating effective July 1, 2026 by the March 3, 2026 vote to close Readsboro Central School.

board.post_note: Readsboro SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423, one 3-year seat elected each year by Australian ballot.

sources.note: Readsboro SD board page (official): Florence (Chair) "3-Year Term, Expires 2029"; Strom-Henriksen (Vice Chair) expires 2028; Irace expires 2027 -- the same three names and offices appear in the district's 2026 Annual Report. The 2026 warning's Article I elects one director for three years by Australian ballot. FLAG: the certified March 3, 2026 return naming the Article I winner was not fetched -- Florence's 2029 expiry on the district's own current page is the roster evidence (the Milton pattern). The voters approved closing Readsboro Central School on March 3, 2026 (warning Arts. V-VI); the district is non-operating effective July 1, 2026 (the district's own post-vote school-choice page corroborates; the same certified return would settle it officially).
